clue.text: Landseer's standing in his craft

parts.note: read Landseer not as the painter but as a land-seer, the sailor on lookout, perched high on the mast of his vessel

explanation.surface: A comment on the reputation the Victorian painter Landseer enjoyed in his art.
explanation.walkthrough: Sir Edwin Landseer was a famous Victorian animal painter, so 'standing in his craft' looks like his artistic reputation; 'craft' is really a ship and 'standing' a literal position.
explanation.definitionFit: The lookout platform at a ship's masthead is where the sailor spotting land would stand.

clue.text: Hordes devastated this area of Greece

indicators.note: something devastated is wrecked, so the letters of the word hordes are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Invading hordes laid waste to a Greek region.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dodecanese island famed for its Colossus is a Greek territory.

clue.text: Quarters housing healthy animals

indicators.note: housing means holding within, so the compass letters wrap around the word for healthy

parts.note: W and S are compass points, quarters of the compass: west and south
hale means healthy, as in hale and hearty

explanation.surface: Living quarters that keep animals in good health.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quarters' looks like lodgings, but it means two compass points, W and S.
explanation.definitionFit: These marine mammals are a class of large animals, so the general word covers them.

clue.text: A man engaged in litigation -a thankless job

indicators.note: engaged in means held within, so the letters run across the clue words litigation, a and thankless

explanation.surface: A man caught up in a lawsuit finds it a thankless task.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a common boy's given name, so any bearer of it is an example of a man.

clue.text: A medical specialist can put drive into a boy

indicators.note: put into says one piece goes inside the other, here the word for drive inside the word for boy

parts.note: a son is a boy, someone's male child
urge means drive, as in an inner impulse

explanation.surface: A specialist doctor is able to motivate a young lad.
explanation.definitionFit: An operating doctor is a medical practitioner who specialises in performing operations.

clue.text: Bombastic, though badly organised

indicators.note: badly organised says the letters of organised are not in good order and need rearranging

explanation.surface: Pompous talk, despite being poorly arranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Grand-sounding, pompous and pretentious language is described as bombastic.

clue.text: Somewhat anxious, not having been paid

definitions.meaning: an outstanding bill is still owing

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both mildly uneasy and, of an account, still owing.

clue.text: Putting new life into others with round after round

parts.note: the rest means the others, the remainder
O is round in shape
a ring is round, a circle

explanation.surface: Reviving others by buying them one round of drinks after another.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' simply places the second round behind the first.
explanation.definitionFit: Reviving or renewing something brings it back to its former vigour.

clue.text: Fruit for a royal house

definitions.meaning: the House of ..., the Dutch royal dynasty that gave Britain William III

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a citrus fruit and the dynasty of William of Orange.

clue.text: Where there's some order in retreat

definitions.text: Where there's some order in retreat

parts.words: Where there's some order in retreat
parts.note: order here is a religious order, and retreat a place of withdrawal from the world, not a military pullback

explanation.surface: A place where discipline survives even as the army falls back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'order in retreat' suggests troops falling back tidily; it is a religious order living in seclusion.
explanation.definitionFit: A community of monks belongs to a religious order and lives apart in a secluded house.

clue.text: Crawler joining the currently popular party

parts.note: in means fashionable, popular at the moment
a sect is a party or faction

explanation.surface: A creep who joins whatever political group is fashionable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crawler' suggests a toady joining a trendy party, but it is a creeping creature.
explanation.definitionFit: A beetle or ant is a small creature that crawls.

clue.text: A musician who's not so bothered about publicity

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for calmer goes round the word for publicity

parts.note: serener means calmer, less bothered
an ad is publicity, an advertisement

explanation.surface: A performer who cares little for fame.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone singing or playing love songs under a window is a kind of musician.

clue.text: Resist forming a relationship

indicators.note: forming means making something new, so the letters of resist are shaped into another word

explanation.surface: Refusing to enter into a romance.
explanation.definitionFit: A female sibling is a family relation; the definition names the relative as a relationship.

clue.text: Take the lead and get on? That's right

parts.note: to star is to take the lead role
to board is to get on a ship or train

explanation.surface: Advice to take charge and climb aboard, approved as correct.
explanation.walkthrough: 'right' seems to mean correct; it is the nautical side.
explanation.definitionFit: On a ship, the side to the right when facing forward has its own nautical name.

clue.text: Swindle vulnerable rival

parts.note: a con is a swindle
tender means sore or vulnerable

explanation.surface: Cheating an opponent who is easily hurt.
explanation.definitionFit: A competitor for a title is a rival to the others.

clue.text: Put off punishing deep river work

indicators.note: work means process or knead into shape, so the letters of deep river are reworked

explanation.surface: Delaying a penalty for some hard labour on a deep river.
explanation.definitionFit: A condemned person granted a stay has had their punishment postponed or cancelled.

clue.text: A state of the USA — no matter which one

parts.note: NY is the abbreviation for New York, a US state

explanation.surface: Picking one American state, it hardly matters which.
explanation.definitionFit: Whichever you like, without restriction, is the sense of no matter which.

clue.text: Article on British sea-fowl

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
UK, the United Kingdom, stands for British

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece on Britain's seabirds.
explanation.definitionFit: This diving seabird, like the razorbill, is a sea-fowl of northern waters.

clue.text: Hankering for Japanese money

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a yearning and the Japanese currency.

clue.text: Tea-hour maybe for a writer

indicators.note: maybe says this is one possible version of the letters of tea-hour, rearranged

explanation.surface: Teatime, perhaps, suits an author.
explanation.definitionFit: Henry David, author of Walden, was an American writer.

clue.text: Egghead going along with a grim Oriental

indicators.note: head means the first letter, the head of the word egg

parts.note: stern means grim, severe

explanation.surface: An intellectual accompanying a sour-faced Asian.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Egghead' looks like an intellectual, but it is split: the head of 'Egg'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something from the Orient is from the East, so the adjective is a synonym.

clue.text: Members of a family, not all good-natured

indicators.note: not all means the word is cut short, its final letter dropped

parts.note: kind means good-natured

explanation.surface: Relatives, some of whom are not pleasant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not all' reads as 'not every relative', but it shortens KIND by its last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Relatives collectively are one's family members.

clue.text: Check if 11 appears soft-hearted

indicators.note: hearted says the letter goes into the heart of the crawler from 11

parts.note: the answer to 11 across, the crawler
p is piano, the musical direction for soft

explanation.surface: See whether the bug from 11 seems to have a gentle nature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'soft-hearted' looks like kindness; it puts P (soft) in the heart of 11's answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To examine something closely is to check it.

clue.text: Still calling for an answer

definitions.meaning: a glass vessel used for distilling, a kind of still

explanation.walkthrough: 'Still' is the noun for distilling apparatus, not the adverb.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a distilling flask and a quick, sharp reply.

clue.text: Favouring growth of the chin

definitions.meaning: mild and warm, as ... weather encourages plants
an anatomical adjective relating to the chin, from Greek geneion

explanation.definitionFit: The word means mild and warm, as weather aiding growth, and, in anatomy, relating to the chin.

clue.text: Issue a high-minded person with a quantity of paper

parts.note: ST is saint, a high-minded holy person
a ream is 500 sheets of paper

explanation.surface: Supplying an idealist with a pile of paper.
explanation.definitionFit: To issue is to flow out, as a liquid streams from a source.

clue.text: Influential businessman

parts.note: co is the abbreviation for company, a business
a gent is a man

explanation.surface: A powerful tycoon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'businessman' is one word in the clue but splits into business and man.
explanation.definitionFit: A convincing, persuasive argument is influential in swaying opinion.

clue.text: An allegation of treason is exceptional

indicators.note: exceptional means out of the ordinary, so the letters of treason is take an unusual order

explanation.surface: Accusing someone of betraying the state is unusual.
explanation.definitionFit: A claim or declaration stated without proof is an allegation.

clue.text: Cats -quite a few for a pound!

definitions.meaning: the snow leopard is also called the ounce, a big cat

definitions.text: quite a few for a pound
definitions.meaning: sixteen of these weights make one pound avoirdupois

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both snow leopards and the units, sixteen to a pound.

clue.text: Each one encountered a certain hesitation on the circuit

parts.note: per means each, as in so much per head
I is the Roman numeral one
met means encountered
er is the sound of hesitating

explanation.surface: Everyone met with some reluctance on the racetrack.
explanation.definitionFit: The boundary line around an area is its circuit.

clue.text: Wavered, but got in line

definitions.meaning: wound in a fishing line on a reel

explanation.walkthrough: 'got in line' sounds like queueing; it is an angler winding in.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both staggered and wound a fishing line in on a reel.

clue.text: Deadlock is far from new to the fellow

parts.note: stale means old, far from fresh
a mate is a fellow or companion

explanation.surface: An impasse is nothing new to the chap.
explanation.definitionFit: A position in chess where no move is possible is a deadlock.
